notes: Original-only fresh blind validation. Source is the supplied published Journal of Consumer Research article, pp. 508–527, with 2019 print year and 2018 advance-access date; no manuscript or appendix substituted. Supplied locator p. 28 does not correspond to the published pagination; the neutral description and Study 3 uniquely locate the large-group independence simple slope on published p. 518. Rendered PDF pages 10–12 inspected directly. The canonical frozen text renders the printed Greek beta as b and equals signs as ¼; quotations preserve those exact canonical glyphs. The rendered page confirms beta .38, t(239) = 3.22 and exact p = .002 for the same test. No metric conversion. Study-wide N = 250 is retained as context rather than asserted as test-specific analytic n. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
